near_zero_definition: zero to two additional narratives, less than one percent of the full fixed copy-cluster cohort
decision: Either c below 25% or full-cohort additional peak-pooled count <=2 rejects; incomplete bounds that cross the rule are inconclusive.
largest_member_definition: largest cumulative gross buy inflow within each cluster; ties lowest mint
weighting_variants: pooled gross-inflow ratio, peak-pooled-reserve weighted mean, snapshot-reserve weighted mean; primary pending clarification
time_horizon: launch through each group atomic snapshot cutoff, matching the 10.18% stock comparison
sampling_order: ascending member count, then root mint, fixed before transaction outcomes
prewindow_root_census: unavailable: no pre-window mint-name catalogue; curve histories do not discover other sibling mints
primary_result: additional simultaneous peak-pooled graduations; c is the preregistered secondary falsification diagnostic
gross_buy_definition: positive reserve-directed buy funding, not buys minus sells; fee-inclusive trader spend reported separately
gap_decomposition: primary-weighting minus pooled-gross c; leader reassignment versus stock leader; fixed-leader retention/capital gap versus stock c
edge_limit: observed edge proximity is a risk diagnostic, not an upper bound on pre-window roots; no hard copy-lag cap follows from a median

collection_amendments.change: signature census deadline extended from 30 to 45 minutes based only on observed RPC throttling; offered rate reduced to 0.8/s; decision rules unchanged
